title: proactive slatecap allocator and cross-pool utilization reconciler
author: Maya Singh
description: Introduce a proactive per-pool "slatecap" allocation and a cross-pool utilization reconciler to reduce transient SLA misses during bursty demand and improve long-tail utilization visibility. Motivation: we observed recurring microbursts where dedicated pools temporarily ran out of soft credits even though nearby pools had spare capacity; reactive provisioning and current warm pools respond too slowly for 99th percentile latency-sensitive tenants. This PR implements a lightweight, aspirational buffer (slatecap) that lives as a small, replenishing soft-credit account per-pool and a controller that periodically reconciles utilization drift across pools and suggests safe cross-pool transients. Key changes: 1) slatecap allocator service (pkg/fleet/slatecap) that maintains per-pool token buckets with replenish logic tuned by historical seqlen/throughput profiles, exposed config via FleetConfig.Slatecap (min_tokens, max_tokens, replenish_rate_ms, emergency_threshold_pct). 2) cross-pool utilization reconciler (controllers/util-reconciler) that computes drift using HDR sketches and proposes ephemeral soft-credit transfers through the existing reservation API; reconciler respects constraints: locality_awareness, hard_reservation_guards, and tenant_priority_slices. 3) Telemetry: new metrics slatecap_available{pool}, slatecap_consumed{pool,tenant}, util_reconciler_drift_ms, util_reconciler_transfer_attempts_total, and debug histogram slatecap_replenish_latency_ms. Metrics are exposed to Prometheus and wired into Console dashboards. 4) API: Fleet admin APIs to query slatecap state and force reconcile (admin/fleet/slatecap: GET/POST). 5) Safety: feature-flag gated (feature.slatecap.enabled) with rollout plan, circuit breaker on transfer failure ratio, and configurable backoff multipliers. 6) Tests: unit tests for allocator logic, integration sim that runs a 1000-req/s microburst scenario, and e2e smoke with two-pool local cluster. 7) Docs and runbook additions describing observability queries and rollback. Rollout: gated to 10% of pools for canary, 1h monitoring window, then staged ramp. Performance: microbench showed median allocation latency 200us and no measurable throughput regression; integration sim reduced 99.9th latency spikes by ~28% under synthetic microbursts. Migration and backward compatibility: slatecap is additive and defaults to disabled; reconciler uses only soft-credit transfers and never touches hard reservations. Related: references ENG-2684 for utilization telemetry improvements and SUP-1198 incident notes. Checklist: - [x] Allocator + reconciler implementation - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Metrics and dashboards - [x] Feature flag + rollout plan - [x] Runbook entry - [x] API docs and admin endpoints

release_notes: Introduce feature-flagged slatecap soft-credit allocator and a cross-pool utilization reconciler to reduce microburst SLA impact; telemetry and admin APIs included. Disabled by default; opt-in via feature.slatecap.enabled.
rollout_plan: Canary 10% pools for 2 hours with monitor dashboard slatecap_canary_overview; abort criteria: transfer_failure_ratio > 0.5% for 10m, 99.9p latency regression > 10%
backout_steps: Disable feature.slatecap.enabled via feature flags and trigger admin POST /admin/fleet/slatecap/force_reconcile to drain slatecap tokens; revert commit if abnormal telemetry persists
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative in transfer sizing and respects locality; future follow-ups planned to make replenishment adaptive by tenant-class and seq-len profile.
